observer_391_api_memo.recommended_mission: local/no-spend no-training architecture and optimization research packet for PopSign fresh5

inference_and_hypotheses.summary: M3CB ruled out the concrete local wiring defects requested by the prior prompt, while M3CA still failed to fit the balanced 125-clip train split under the local cap and M3BV fit only a five-clip deterministic subset. The remaining plausible causes are not one proven bug; they are architecture, optimization, input-family, crop/region-target, and distribution hypotheses that require design review or no-training diagnostics before another fitting run.

evidence_for: M3CA loss fell from 1.8743968796730042 to 0.9130748319625854, so the loop learned signal.
M3CA still reached only 0.464 eval-train accuracy under 40 epochs with batch size 5, learning rate 0.003, and weight decay 0.0.
evidence_against_or_unknown: No alternate schedule, regularization, or curriculum has been reviewed against the current M3CB evidence.
Training is not authorized by this packet.

evidence_for: The true TCN can memorize five clips but not the 125-clip train split under cap.
M3CB found no shape/loss/target defect, so a representational or capacity mismatch remains plausible.
evidence_against_or_unknown: Parameter count 1290470 is nontrivial, so the issue is not proven to be simple undercapacity.
No from-scratch alternative has a reviewed browser-size budget yet.

evidence_for: The current evidence involves isolated signs whose discriminative cues may depend on motion over time.
M3BU motion_2d_temporal_cnn and M3CA true_temporal_convnet_region_grid both remain weak on held-out metrics.
evidence_against_or_unknown: M3CA did improve train loss, so temporal modeling is not proven to be absent.
No no-training audit has compared temporal receptive-field choices against clip statistics.

evidence_for: M3CA uses fixed region tensors, and class cues such as pen may be small or hand-object localized.
evidence_against_or_unknown: M3CB proved the region-axis path is mechanically preserved and not falling back to rgb_frames.
M3BV memorized one clip per label through the same preserved-region family.

evidence_for: The train split has only 25 clips per label and validation/test signers are disjoint.
evidence_against_or_unknown: M3CA also failed train-all sanity, so held-out distribution alone cannot explain the failure.
Data mutation or source expansion is not authorized.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: class-specific failures for pen and thank_you
evidence_for: M3BU and M3CA both show pen recall at 0.04.
M3BU thank_you recall was high while M3BW had thank_you overprediction; M3CA reduced thank_you prediction fraction to 0.048 but recall is still weak.
evidence_against_or_unknown: M3CB found no label-index defect, so class-specific failure is likely signal, crop, or distribution rather than target wiring.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: browser deployment constraints constrain architecture choices
evidence_for: The promoted lane must run in the browser and cannot use pretrained CV/sign/landmark/model dependencies.
The current model remains fail-closed with no active labels.
evidence_against_or_unknown: Browser constraints do not explain the current local train-all failure by themselves.
No export or browser activation is authorized until training evidence exists.

The next non-wasteful local slice is a no-training design review that converts this ranked packet into one specific from-scratch proposal and validation contract, without approving fitting or compute.
